# Rule 3 — No ERP or sexual content
Erotic roleplay, sexual content, and sexually explicit behavior are not allowed.
Do not make sexual comments toward other players, characters, or staff. Do not use emotes, descriptions, names, jokes, or roleplay scenarios to create sexual content.
Romance or flirting should stay mild, consensual, and non-explicit. If someone is uncomfortable or asks you to stop, stop immediately.
Extreme, illegal, or non-consensual sexual themes are strictly forbidden and may result in an immediate permanent ban.
